newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's JSE mulls extending Friday's trade.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's JSE mulls extending Friday's trade.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange said it was considering extending Friday's trade by an hour after a network problem which caused activity to grind to a halt for nearly five hours.
"We are considering extending the hours of trade. We are gathering all the information and we will issue a comprehensive statement later on," JSE president Roy Andersen told Reuters.
He said trade was initially delayed by five minutes at the official opening and failed again at around 0800 GMT due to a network problem.
